summary.summary: Sandy Balak called Arizona Roofers requesting an estimate and inspection for her roof because she can see a couple of broken tiles and at least one loose/misaligned tile, and she is unsure of the overall roof condition due to its age. Travis confirmed they service her area (22042 N Reis Dr, Maricopa, in Rancho El Dorado) and noted the property appears to be a one-story tile roof with some flat roofing over the back patio. He collected contact details, confirmed the home is in an HOA but not gated, and noted there are indoor cats only. Sandy agreed to receive text updates and provided an email address. They scheduled an on-site visit/inspection for the following Monday between 1–3 PM, with the specific rep to be assigned closer to the appointment.
key_points: Customer requested an estimate/inspection due to visible broken tiles and a loose/misaligned tile, and wants it checked before the next monsoon season.
Property details discussed: one-story tile roof with some flat roof area over the back patio; address is 22042 N Reis Dr in Rancho El Dorado (Maricopa).
HOA community confirmed; not gated; pets are indoor cats only; appointment scheduled for Monday 1–3 PM with text updates allowed.
action_items: Dispatch a roofing rep to perform the scheduled on-site roof inspection/estimate during the Monday 1–3 PM window.
Assign/confirm which of the two reps will attend and notify Sandy via text updates.
next_steps: Company completes the site visit to assess broken/loose tiles and overall roof condition.
After inspection, provide Sandy with the estimate and recommended repairs.

pending_actions.raw_text: I'll set it in schedule... I have you in the schedule between 1 to 3.
Most likely it's between 2 reps, but I'll schedule it usually the Friday before.

issues: Did not verify/confirm the full address back to the customer (rep stated an address/ZIP but did not have the customer explicitly confirm it).

Limited needs discovery: did not ask how long the issue has been present, whether anyone has inspected it, or any additional roof details beyond what he pulled up (age, leak symptoms, interior damage).
Did not set clear appointment expectations (what will happen during the inspection, approximate duration, what the customer will receive, and next steps).
Close lacked confirmation delivery details (no mention of sending a confirmation text/email with appointment window and company contact info).
No explicit qualification of decision-maker status (homeowner/authorized to approve work).
positive_behaviors: Professional greeting with company name and rep name; asked for caller name.
Captured and verified key contact details (phone confirmation, permission for text updates, email).
Confirmed service area and gathered property access details (HOA, gate status, pets).
Offered scheduling options and worked around the customer’s availability to secure an appointment window.
Maintained a friendly, conversational tone while keeping the call moving toward scheduling.

objections.objection_text: You picked one day I had something going at 1 o'clock.

qualification.service_requested: Roof inspection/estimate for loose and broken roof tiles (possible roof repair)
